1800: Hold the cable attachment or handles with both hands at about chest height.
Lean back with straight arms and sit your hips back until you feel your back lengthen.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1801: Stand tall and hold a pole or frame with one hand above head height.
Lean away from the arm and sit your hips slightly back to feel a stretch along your side.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1802: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and raise one arm overhead.
Lean to the opposite side from the raised arm, reaching over without twisting.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1803: Sit on the floor or a bench with your knees slightly bent and your feet flat.
Round your back and fold your chest toward your thighs, letting your arms hang down.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1804: Sit tall on a chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor.
Fold forward and reach your hands toward one foot, letting your trunk bend slightly to that side.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1805: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat and your knees apart.
Bend forward from your hips and let your head and arms hang between your knees.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1806: Sit tall with your legs crossed or your feet flat and place one hand on the floor beside you.
Reach your other arm up and over your head toward the side, lengthening along your flank.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1807: Sit on the floor with your legs crossed and your back tall.
Walk your hands forward along the floor and fold from your hips until you feel a stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1808: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Draw both knees toward your chest and hold them with your hands.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1809: Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet together and your knees falling out.
Hold your feet and fold forward from your hips, keeping your spine long.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1810: Lie on your back with both legs extended.
Pull one knee toward your chest with both hands while the other leg stays flat.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1811: Stand tall, using a wall for balance if needed.
Lift one knee and pull it gently toward your chest with both hands.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1812: Start on your hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders.
Place one hand behind your head and rotate your elbow up toward the ceiling.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1813: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms at chest height.
Rotate your upper body to one side, keeping your hips facing forward.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1814: Extend one arm in front of you with your palm facing up.
Use your other hand to gently press the fingers down and back until you feel the stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1815: Extend one arm in front of you with your elbow straight and palm down.
Use your other hand to rotate the palm outward until you feel a stretch along your forearm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1816: Stand tall with your arms raised straight overhead.
Press your arms back slightly and reach long through your fingertips.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1817: Place your hands or forearms on a bench or other stable support behind you.
Lower your body slightly and lean away until you feel a stretch in the front of your arms.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1818: Grip a pull-up bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Let your body hang with your arms straight, relaxing your shoulders downward.
Take as much weight through your legs as you need to stay comfortable.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1819: Hold a pulley handle with an underhand grip and your arm straight.
Lean your body weight back gently until you feel a stretch in the biceps and forearm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1820: Sit at a preacher bench and rest your upper arms on the pad, holding an EZ bar.
Let the bar lower under control until your arms are fully extended, using a light load.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1821: Extend one arm in front of you with your elbow straight.
Slowly rotate your palm up and down and let your other hand add gentle pressure at each end.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1822: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm down.
Bend the wrist so your fingers point down.
Gently tilt the hand toward the little finger side.
Use the other hand to apply light pressure.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.
1823: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm down.
Bend the wrist so your fingers point down.
Gently tilt the hand toward the thumb side.
Use the other hand to apply light pressure.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.
1824: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm up.
Use your other hand to pull the fingers back toward you.
Gently tilt the hand toward the thumb side.
Keep the elbow straight and your shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.
1825: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm up.
Use your other hand to pull the fingers back toward you.
Gently tilt the hand toward the little finger side.
Keep the elbow straight and your shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.
1826: Extend one arm forward with your palm facing up or out.
Use your other hand to gently pull your fingers and palm back toward you.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1827: Extend one arm forward with your palm facing down and your wrist relaxed.
Use your other hand to gently press your fingers and hand down toward you.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1828: Raise one arm overhead, bend the elbow and drop your hand behind your head.
Use your other hand to press your elbow gently back and down.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1829: Stand next to a wall and place your bent elbow on it above head height.
Lean your body forward and down until you feel the stretch along the back of your upper arm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1830: Extend one arm forward and bend the elbow fully with your palm down.
Use your other hand to press your forearm toward your upper arm, then rotate it gently.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1831: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly turn your head to one side, then to the other, as far as is comfortable.
Keep your chin level and avoid pushing into any pain.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1832: Sit tall and gently turn your head about 45 degrees to one side.
Drop your chin diagonally toward your chest, using your hand for light added pressure.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1833: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly tilt your head back to look up at the ceiling, keeping your jaw relaxed.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
1834: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Keep your eyes level and slide your chin and head straight forward.
Stop when you feel a stretch at the back of the neck.
Draw your head back to neutral and relax.
1835: Sit tall on a chair with your hands resting in your lap.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest.
Let the weight of your head do the work, without forcing it.
Lift your head back to neutral slowly.
1836: Stand or sit tall with your shoulders down.
Place both hands lightly behind your head.
Let your elbows drop forward and ease your head toward your chest.
Release your hands and return to neutral.
1837: Sit tall with your back straight.
Tuck your chin toward your chest.
Rest one hand on the back of your head and add very light pressure down.
Remove your hand and lift your head slowly.
1838: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Turn your head about 45 degrees to one side.
Rest a hand on the back of your head and ease your nose toward your armpit.
1839: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Lift your chin and slowly tilt your head back.
Keep the movement small and comfortable.
1840: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders down.
Turn your head slightly to one side.
Tilt your chin up and back until you feel a stretch along the front of your neck.
1841: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Clasp your hands behind your head.
Gently lift your head and ease your chin toward your chest.
Lower your head back down slowly.
1842: Lie on your back with your head near the edge of a bench or bed, shoulders supported.
Slowly let your head relax backward past the edge.
Support it with your hands if it feels heavy.
Use your hands to lift your head back up carefully.
1843: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Turn your head to one side as far as is comfortable.
Place one hand on your chin and the other on the back of your head.
Add light pressure to deepen the turn.
1844: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders down.
Lower one ear toward the same shoulder.
1845: Lie on a decline bench and hold the top edge above your head.
Bring your knees up and bend them.
Curl your hips off the bench, drawing your knees toward your chest.
Lower back down slowly without swinging.
1848: Stand facing a wall with one foot back and your heel on the floor.
Keep your back leg straight and lean toward the wall.
Press your back heel down until you feel a stretch in the calf.
Keep your hips square and your toes pointing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
1850: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm up.
Use your other hand to pull the fingers back toward you.
Keep your elbow straight and your shoulder relaxed.
Feel the stretch along the inner forearm.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.
1851: Set an incline bench and hold the bar at your upper chest.
Dip slightly through your legs to start momentum.
Drive the bar up while pressing with your arms.
Lock out above your chest, then lower under control.
Keep your core braced and your lower back from arching.
1852: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands by your sides.
Curl your hips up off the floor, pushing your feet toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips, then your legs, with control.
Keep your movement smooth and avoid swinging.
1854: Lie on your back with your hands under your hips.
Bend your knees slightly and lift your feet off the floor.
Raise your legs until they are above your hips.
Lower slowly without letting your back arch.
1855: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands by your sides.
Lift your head and shoulders slightly off the floor.
Push your hips a little off the floor, lifting your feet toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips and legs slowly with control.
1856: Lie back on the machine and grip the handles.
Bend your knees and place your legs under the pads.
Curl your knees up toward your chest.
Lower slowly until you feel tension, then repeat.
1857: Adjust the seat and sit with your chest against the pad.
Hold the handles and set your feet firmly.
Curl your torso forward by contracting your abs.
Return slowly to the start without letting the weight drop.
1858: Lie back on the decline seat and hook your feet under the pads.
Cross your arms or hold the handles.
Curl your torso up toward your knees.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
1859: Attach a rope or bar to a high pulley and kneel facing away.
Hold it overhead with your elbows bent behind your head.
Keep your upper arms still and straighten your elbows.
Squeeze your triceps at full extension.
1860: Set the pad at hip level and hook your heels under the rollers.
Cross your arms over your chest and keep your body straight.
Bend forward at the hips with a flat back.
Lift your torso until it forms a straight line with your legs.
Do not overarch at the top, then lower with control.
1861: Attach a multipurpose V bar to a low pulley and grip it with palms up.
Stand tall with your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly without letting your elbows drift.
1862: Adjust the seat so the handles are at shoulder height.
Sit back with your feet flat and grip the handles.
Press upward until your arms are nearly straight.
Lower slowly back to the start.
1863: Adjust the seat and grip the handles overhead.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handles down, driving your elbows toward your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the bottom.
1864: Set a decline bench to a steep angle and hook your feet under the pads.
Lie back and cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your torso up until you are sitting.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
1865: Grab the neutral grip handles with your palms facing each other.
Hang with your arms fully extended.
Pull your chest toward the handles by driving your elbows down.
Pause with your chin above the bars.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
1866: Grab the wide handles with your palms facing forward.
Hang with your arms fully extended.
Pull yourself up by driving your elbows down and back.
Pause when your chin clears the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
1867: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad.
Place your legs against the pads, set wide.
Pause for a moment when they meet.
Open slowly back to the start.
1868: Set the bar in the rack and place it on your rear delts, below the traps.
Step back and set your feet shoulder width.
Lean forward slightly and sit your hips back and down.
Descend until your thighs are at least parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand, keeping your chest up.
1869: Sit with your back against the pad and your legs inside the pads.
Return slowly without letting the weights crash.
1870: Adjust the seat and grip the handles overhead.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull down until the handles reach chest level.
1871: Sit upright and grip the handles beside you.
Set your elbows tight to your sides.
Press down until your arms are straight.
1872: Adjust the seat so your upper arms rest on the pad.
Grip the handles with your palms up.
Curl up until your biceps are fully contracted.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.
1873: Sit with your back against the pad and your shins behind the roller.
Extend your knees until your legs are straight.
Squeeze your quads at the top.
1874: Sit with your back against the pad and your shins behind the rollers.
Extend one leg until it is straight.
Repeat with the other leg and keep alternating.
1875: Step under the shoulder pads and set your feet shoulder width.
Release the safeties and stand tall.
Sit down and back until your thighs are parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes.
1876: Adjust the seat and place your arms against the pads.
Raise your arms out to the sides until about shoulder height.
1877: Stand tall with your feet wider than hip width.
Shift your weight onto one leg and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight, foot flat.
Push your hip out until you feel a stretch in the inner thigh.
1878: Stand tall, next to a wall if you need balance.
Cross one leg behind the other.
Lean your hips toward the side of your back leg.
Feel the stretch along the outer hip.
1879: Stand facing a bench or step.
Place one heel on it with the knee slightly bent.
Keep your chest tall and hinge forward at the hips.
Feel the stretch in the hip and glute.
1880: Stand next to a wall and lean on it with one hand.
Cross your outer leg behind the inner one.
Lean your hips toward the wall.
1881: Pass one leg behind and under the other.
Push your hips gently to the side of the back leg.
1882: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Bring one knee up and across your body.
Use the opposite hand to ease it toward the floor.
Keep your shoulders flat on the ground.
1883: Lie on your back with your calves resting on a stability ball.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Roll the ball gently to bring your legs toward your chest.
Feel the stretch in the outer hip.
1884: Lie on your back on a bench.
Cross one leg over your body and let it hang off the side.
Let gravity lower the leg slowly.
1885: Stand facing a wall with one foot forward.
Place the ball of the forward foot against the wall, heel on the floor.
Lean your hips toward the wall.
Feel the stretch in the calf and Achilles.
1886: Stand on a step with the ball of one foot on the edge.
Lower your heel slowly below the step.
Keep the knee straight for the calf, then slightly bent for the soleus.
1887: Stand facing a wall and step one foot back.
Keep the back leg straight and the heel down.
Bend your front knee and lean forward.
Feel the stretch in the back calf.
1888: Stand near a wall or support.
Step one foot back with the heel down.
Slightly bend the back knee to target the lower Achilles.
Keep your back foot pointing forward.
1889: Sit on the floor with one leg straight.
Loop a towel around the ball of your foot or grip your toes.
Pull your toes toward your shin.
1890: Crouch down with your hands on the floor for balance.
Extend one leg back with the heel down.
Press the heel toward the floor.
1891: Kneel on a mat with your toes tucked under.
Sit back onto your heels slowly.
Rest your hands on your thighs.
Ease off if the stretch is too sharp.
Release and shake out your feet.
1892: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward.
Lean forward, keeping your front heel on the floor.
Press your front knee over your toes.
Feel the stretch behind the ankle.
1893: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Sink into a deep squat with your heels down.
Hold on to a support if needed.
Gently shift your weight forward over your toes.
1894: Stand with your feet wide apart and toes pointing slightly out.
Bend your knees and place your hands on your thighs.
Shift your weight from side to side, sinking into the stretch.
Keep your chest tall and your back flat.
Hold for 20-30 seconds on each side.
1895: Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Sit your hips back as if sitting into a chair.
Feel the stretch in the hip of the crossed leg.
1896: Stand tall and place one foot on a bench or raised surface to the side.
Keep your standing leg straight and your toes forward.
Shift your weight toward the raised leg side until you feel a stretch.
Keep your chest upright and your hips square.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
1897: Stand next to a bench or low support.
Place one foot on it with the leg out to the side.
Shift your weight toward the raised leg.
1898: Kneel on all fours with your knees under your hips.
Extend one leg out to the side with the foot flat.
Sit your hips back toward the opposite heel.
Keep your back straight and your extended leg straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
1899: Stand with your feet wide apart.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight with the foot flat.
